A court would not enforce the bar against the distributor's assignment of the right to the $30,000. A general ban on assigning "the contract or any of its terms" is read to restrict only delegation of duties, not the right to receive payment, unless the clause specifically bars assigning payment rights (see UCC § 2-210(3) and Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 322). The assignment would still take effect, though the distributor could be liable to the center for breaching the no-assignment promise, and the team note's presumption runs the other way from these rules.

CONFIDENCE: 75
